referenceFunction.includedProcesses: 1 meter of noise barrier wall installed along the roadside in open terrain. Total visible height: 3.2 meters, consisting of a ribbed concrete panel with a height of 3.0 meters. Process includes the production phase (A1–A3), the construction phase/ transport (A4–A5) as well as deconstruction phase (C1), transport phase (C2), treatment/ recycling phase (C3), and final disposal phase (C4) for one meter of noise barrier wall. Service life 80 years.
